input: Book a professional voice lesson for beginners

gold.taskTitle: Book a beginner professional voice lesson
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and book a professional voice lesson suited for beginners.

questions.title: Is this lesson for you or someone else?
questions.description: Identify who the voice lesson is intended for.

questions.title: What style of singing do you want to learn?
questions.description: Determine the preferred vocal genre such as classical, pop, musical theatre, or other.

questions.title: Do you prefer in-person or online lessons?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred lesson format to narrow down suitable teachers.

questions.title: What city or region should the teacher be based in?
questions.description: Establish the geographic location relevant to finding a local or nearby instructor.

questions.title: What is your budget per lesson session?
questions.description: Understand the price range the user is comfortable with per lesson.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred day or time for lessons?
questions.description: Identify scheduling constraints or preferences to match with teacher availability.

questions.title: How soon do you want the first lesson to happen?
questions.description: Determine the urgency or target start date for beginning lessons.
